title.zh-TW: 確認彈窗（手機變底部抽屜）
title.en: Confirm modal that becomes a bottom sheet

summary.zh-TW: 按「Delete project」打開確認彈窗：背景變暗，電腦版從下方稍微浮起、手機版從畫面底部整個滑上來。同一個元件依螢幕寬度切換，Esc、點背景都能關閉。
summary.en: Delete project opens a confirmation: the background dims, and the dialog rises slightly on desktop or slides up from the bottom on phones. One component switches by screen width; Esc or clicking outside closes it.

text.zh-TW: 用原生的 <dialog>：焦點自動關在彈窗裡、後面的內容不能點、Esc 可以關閉、關閉後焦點回到原本的按鈕。這些無障礙細節自己做很容易漏。
text.en: The native <dialog> traps focus, blocks the page behind, closes on Esc and returns focus to the button afterwards — accessibility details that are easy to miss when hand-rolled.

text.zh-TW: 按 Esc 時瀏覽器會「立刻」關掉彈窗，關閉動畫就看不到了。先攔下來，播完動畫再 close()。
text.en: Esc closes the dialog instantly, skipping the exit animation. Intercept it, play the animation, then call close().

text.zh-TW: 瀏覽器內建的 ::backdrop 沒辦法用 GSAP 控制，所以設成透明，改用一個自己的 .scrim 圖層做淡入淡出。
text.en: The built-in ::backdrop can’t be animated by GSAP, so it’s made transparent and a separate .scrim layer handles the fade.

text.zh-TW: 同一段程式，依 matchMedia 決定起點：手機從底部整個滑上來（底部抽屜），電腦從稍微下面、稍微小一點浮上來（置中彈窗）。
text.en: The same code picks its start state with matchMedia: phones slide the whole sheet up from the bottom; desktops rise a little from slightly below and slightly smaller.

text.zh-TW: 關閉（0.3 秒）比打開（0.5 秒）快。使用者已經做完決定，收起來要俐落，不要讓人等。
text.en: Closing (0.3s) is faster than opening (0.5s). The user has already decided — get out of the way quickly.
